g.title: diagnosis_data
g.text: Diagnosis data collection: 62 datasets, 13 GB, 6 layers. Columns = layers; centre column = identifier hubs. Arrow colour = identifier used to join a dataset to a hub. Grey dashed = xref / string-only / not downloaded.
